title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Full Stack Developer" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Transportation vouchers

Gympass

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Consultor(a) SAP FICO
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:

  • Papel principal na coordenação de equipes de mapeamento, implantação e operação de soluções corporativas.
  • Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos SAP, garantindo a entrega conforme cronograma e orçamento.
  • Gerenciar demandas corretivas, evolutivas e melhorias contínuas em sistemas SAP.
  • Conduzir reuniões de status, elaborar relatórios e indicadores de performance (KPIs).
  • Garantir a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Activate ou híbrido).
  • Atuar na gestão de riscos, mudanças e comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Interagir com as equipes funcionais e técnicas, garantindo a execução eficiente dos projetos.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a alocação de recursos SAP junto a liderança de delivery conforme necessidade e prioridade dos projetos


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharia da Computação;
  • Certificação oficial PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PgMP (Program Management Professional);
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos SAP em empresa de Saneamento Básico e/ou Utilities;
  • Conhecimento de Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Ter atuado com demandas AMS SAP;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Trello, MS Project, Asana, Monday.com).
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Pensamento analítico e foco em resultados. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação com múltiplas áreas. Perfil colaborativo, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares. Proatividade, autonomia e senso de urgência. Visão centrada no cliente, com capacidade de equilibrar expectativas e metas de negócio.


Regime de Contratação: CLT

Atuação: Remota com Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais ao cliente.


Junte-se ao nosso time inspirador, confiável e solidário. Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho, valorizamos a integridade e a responsabilidade pessoal em todos os níveis desde o primeiro dia, tratamos todos com dignidade e respeito, e estendemos nossa responsabilidade à nossa comunidade, à sociedade e ao meio ambiente.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: OutSystems Developer (SAP Integration)
description:
Project description


We are seeking an experienced OutSystems Developer with a strong background in integrating SAP backend systems. The ideal candidate will be skilled in leveraging enterprise data and business logic to build scalable, high-performance applications using the OutSystems low-code platform.


Responsibilities


Develop and maintain applications using OutSystems platform

Design and implement integrations with SAP backend systems, including data exchange and business logic alignment

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

Ensure performance, scalability, and security of applications

Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues and application defects


Skills

Must have

Proven expertise in OutSystems development

Hands-on experience integrating with SAP backend systems (e.g., via OData, BAPIs, RFCs, or APIs)

Strong understanding of enterprise data models and business process logic

Familiarity with web services (REST/SOAP), SQL, and application lifecycle management

Ability to work in agile environments and communicate effectively with stakeholders

title: Coletor de Mídia
description:
Responsável pela coleta de dados de programação e veiculações em diferentes plataformas de mídia, como TV aberta, TV fechada, rádio, serviços de streaming, etc.


Atividades :


  • Coletar todos os dias a programação e os intervalos comerciais de todas as plataformas de mídia que fazem parte da cobertura da Kantar.
  • Avisar a área de suporte sempre que houver alguma falha na gravação de um programa ou intervalo, para que possam identificar e corrigir o problema.
  • Informar a equipe de Preços quando houver diferença entre o programa cadastrado no sistema e o que foi realmente exibido.
  • Garantir que o registro dos anunciantes exibidos esteja correto. Se não for possível identificar o anunciante, acionar a área de Pesquisa para confirmar com as agências.
  • Testar e validar melhorias no sistema que impactem o trabalho do dia a dia.
  • Revisar e corrigir eventuais erros identificados.
  • Participar dos projetos da área sempre que for solicitado.
  • Realizar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação do superior.


Escala: 5x2 Rotativa, garantindo 2 folgas por semana e 1 fim de semana por mês;

Horário de trabalho: 14h às 23h

Modelo : 100% remoto


O que é necessário?

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário de Informática (Pcte Office, Edição de Vídeos, etc.)


Desejável :

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando: em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Rádio e TV ou relacionados.


O que oferecemos:

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Salário fixo
  • Ajuda de custo
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Convênio com Farmácias;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida: Total Pass; ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana; palestras sobre temas relevantes; vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais.
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+

A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Payment in dollars.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Analista de Monitoramento/BI
description:
Analista de Monitoramento e BI Sênior


Irá atuar tanto em BI quanto em monitoramento, atuando de forma mais técnica para apoiar automações e melhorias de processos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Monitoramento e análise aprofundada durante o horário comercial.
  • Identificação e classificação de temas sensíveis.
  • Desenvolvimento de automação de processos (dashboards, relatórios dinâmicos, alertas automáticos).
  • Gestão da interface técnica e metodológica com o parceiro externo.
  • Elaboração de relatórios de performance e recomendações estratégicas.


Perfil desejado:

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de monitoramento (Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Stilingue e etc.).
  • Habilidade em automação de dados e visualização (Power BI, Python básico, Big Query e integrações via API).
  • Perfil analítico, com visão estratégica e capacidade de traduzir dados em insights de negócio.


Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Assistência Médica;

title: Coordenador de operações
description:
Responsabilidades:


Gerir a equipe de atendimento, assegurando cumprimento de metas de produtividade, qualidade e experiência do cliente.


Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), como SLA, TMA, NPS, FCR, absenteísmo e turnover, propondo ações corretivas baseadas em dados.


Acompanhar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards para apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança e identificar tendências de performance.


Condução de reuniões de resultados, semanais com clientes e gestão.


Desenvolver planos de ação voltados para a melhoria contínua da operação, baseando-se em análise crítica de resultados.


Atuar na identificação de gaps operacionais e propor soluções estruturadas que garantam maior eficiência nos processos.


Colaborar com áreas de suporte (RH, WFM, Qualidade, Treinamento e TI) para alinhamento de estratégias e implementação de melhorias.


Gerir a rotina diária da equipe, garantindo o equilíbrio entre demandas operacionais e bem-estar dos colaboradores.


Apoiar programas de engajamento e motivação, utilizando insights de dados para antecipar riscos de insatisfação ou alta rotatividade.


Garantir a aderência às políticas internas, compliance e normas regulatórias do setor.




Requisitos:


Perfil analítico desejado.


Forte capacidade de análise de dados, identificação de padrões e construção de insights acionáveis.


Domínio de ferramentas, Excel e facilidade com relatórios de performance.


Visão estratégica para transformar números em planos de ação eficazes.


Habilidade em tomar decisões baseadas em fatos e dados, sem perder a sensibilidade para gestão de pessoas.


Comunicação clara e assertiva para traduzir análises em direcionamentos operacionais compreensíveis para a equipe.


Estudos Ensino Superior


Idiomas Espanhol (Bilingue)


Competências

Trabalho sob pressão

Gestão de Pessoas

Controle de indicadores

Resiliência

Trabalho em equipe

Valorizado

Experiência profissional mais de 1 ano como coordenador

title: Consultor(a) SAP FICO
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:

  • Papel principal na coordenação de equipes de mapeamento, implantação e operação de soluções corporativas.
  • Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos SAP, garantindo a entrega conforme cronograma e orçamento.
  • Gerenciar demandas corretivas, evolutivas e melhorias contínuas em sistemas SAP.
  • Conduzir reuniões de status, elaborar relatórios e indicadores de performance (KPIs).
  • Garantir a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Activate ou híbrido).
  • Atuar na gestão de riscos, mudanças e comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Interagir com as equipes funcionais e técnicas, garantindo a execução eficiente dos projetos.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a alocação de recursos SAP junto a liderança de delivery conforme necessidade e prioridade dos projetos


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharia da Computação;
  • Certificação oficial PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PgMP (Program Management Professional);
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos SAP em empresa de Saneamento Básico e/ou Utilities;
  • Conhecimento de Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Ter atuado com demandas AMS SAP;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Trello, MS Project, Asana, Monday.com).
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Pensamento analítico e foco em resultados. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação com múltiplas áreas. Perfil colaborativo, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares. Proatividade, autonomia e senso de urgência. Visão centrada no cliente, com capacidade de equilibrar expectativas e metas de negócio.


Regime de Contratação: CLT

Atuação: Remota com Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais ao cliente.


Junte-se ao nosso time inspirador, confiável e solidário. Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho, valorizamos a integridade e a responsabilidade pessoal em todos os níveis desde o primeiro dia, tratamos todos com dignidade e respeito, e estendemos nossa responsabilidade à nossa comunidade, à sociedade e ao meio ambiente.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: OutSystems Developer (SAP Integration)
description:
Project description


We are seeking an experienced OutSystems Developer with a strong background in integrating SAP backend systems. The ideal candidate will be skilled in leveraging enterprise data and business logic to build scalable, high-performance applications using the OutSystems low-code platform.


Responsibilities


Develop and maintain applications using OutSystems platform

Design and implement integrations with SAP backend systems, including data exchange and business logic alignment

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions

Ensure performance, scalability, and security of applications

Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues and application defects


Skills

Must have

Proven expertise in OutSystems development

Hands-on experience integrating with SAP backend systems (e.g., via OData, BAPIs, RFCs, or APIs)

Strong understanding of enterprise data models and business process logic

Familiarity with web services (REST/SOAP), SQL, and application lifecycle management

Ability to work in agile environments and communicate effectively with stakeholders

title: Coletor de Mídia
description:
Responsável pela coleta de dados de programação e veiculações em diferentes plataformas de mídia, como TV aberta, TV fechada, rádio, serviços de streaming, etc.


Atividades :


  • Coletar todos os dias a programação e os intervalos comerciais de todas as plataformas de mídia que fazem parte da cobertura da Kantar.
  • Avisar a área de suporte sempre que houver alguma falha na gravação de um programa ou intervalo, para que possam identificar e corrigir o problema.
  • Informar a equipe de Preços quando houver diferença entre o programa cadastrado no sistema e o que foi realmente exibido.
  • Garantir que o registro dos anunciantes exibidos esteja correto. Se não for possível identificar o anunciante, acionar a área de Pesquisa para confirmar com as agências.
  • Testar e validar melhorias no sistema que impactem o trabalho do dia a dia.
  • Revisar e corrigir eventuais erros identificados.
  • Participar dos projetos da área sempre que for solicitado.
  • Realizar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação do superior.


Escala: 5x2 Rotativa, garantindo 2 folgas por semana e 1 fim de semana por mês;

Horário de trabalho: 14h às 23h

Modelo : 100% remoto


O que é necessário?

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário de Informática (Pcte Office, Edição de Vídeos, etc.)


Desejável :

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando: em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Rádio e TV ou relacionados.


O que oferecemos:

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Salário fixo
  • Ajuda de custo
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Convênio com Farmácias;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida: Total Pass; ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana; palestras sobre temas relevantes; vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais.
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

description:

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.
